text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I heard all about it, Shion~! 
You were the star of the practice race, they say?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! ...Yes! 
I was in much better form than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Although... everyone really is strong. 
They have talents I don't. I'm envious.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~, I know the feeling. 
A razor-sharp closing kick, stamina that just won't quit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You want a "weapon," don't you~. 
Something to go toe-to-toe with the sparkly genius types.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A weapon... a weapon, huh... 
What have I got, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Found Nature and Shion~! 
Hey, hey, you two play with Turbo and the others!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Oni♪ Follow the clapping♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...! Over... here~~...?

Lunch break. I spotted Win Variation 
playing with the other horsegirls, 
so I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Blindfolded tag. We take turns being the oni 
and compete over how many we can catch.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The oni closes their eyes and goes after people 
by the sound of clapping, but it's surprisingly hard.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Is Shion's trainer interested too? 
You can join Turbo and the others!

And so I closed my eyes 
and took a turn as the oni, but...

text_block_list.name: Umas
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Oni♪ Follow the clapping♪
choice_data_list: (This way? But it's kind of scary to walk...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems Shion's trainer 
didn't fare very well either.
choice_data_list: Harder than I expected... being the oni
Harder than I expected... being the oni

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Even when you know the direction, 
it's weirdly hard to walk in a straight line.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, Shion's the next oni, then. 
Ready?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Umas
text_block_list.text: Over here, Mr. Oni♪ Follow the clapping♪

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hmm, over this way?

Win Variation closes her eyes and starts walking. 
I thought she'd have a hard time of it too, but...
(Stride, stride, stride...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Right there!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You're not getting away!

Win Variation caught one horsegirl after another. 
Her footing was completely steady.
choice_data_list: How can she walk so steadily...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! That voice... you're over here.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: --Trainer, caught you!

In the end, the oni who caught the most that day 
was Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And so the winner, Shion, 
gets treated to a carrot juice~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, isn't it~. Even with her eyes closed, 
she just goes stride-stride~~... mm!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... is that amazing? 
If it's somewhere I know well, 
I can walk with my eyes closed, but...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fantastico!! 
Shion, che talento!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You could really make that quality your selling point! 
As the "eyes-closed horsegirl"!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat...?! 
No, you're praising me far too much...
choice_data_list: Maybe we could use this in training?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Talent... A talent, huh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......H-Huh? 
What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's a little warm... maybe... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: What, really?!

Some days later. Making use of Win Variation's knack, 
I put together training to sharpen her five senses 
and her sense of balance.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I always thought being able to walk with my eyes closed 
was no use at all in a race, but...
choice_data_list: I think there are abilities only you can sharpen, Shion

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because it's me--...! 
Yes, I'll show you what I can do...!
